description: Admin image management + hard-delete UI + sample sub-image seed. Show a product thumbnail in the admin product list; let the create form optionally upload multiple sub-images; in each row's edit mode let the admin replace the main image and add/remove sub-images; add a red 'Delete permanently' button separate from 'Deactivate'; and add an idempotent script to attach sample sub-images to the 4 existing products. Depends on FEAT-001 (API routes, schema, getProduct). Grounded in: src/app/(admin)/admin/products/page.tsx renders a table with columns Name/Dial/Price/Stock/Actions via ProductRow; product-form.tsx holds the sign->upload->save Cloudinary flow; product-row.tsx has inline edit + a Deactivate (soft-delete DELETE) action; PATCH /api/products/[id] already accepts imageUrl + imagePublicId.
steps: Create src/lib/upload-image.ts (client util, no 'use client' needed for a plain module): export `uploadImageToCloudinary(file: File): Promise<{ url: string; publicId: string }>` implementing the existing flow from product-form.tsx — POST /api/uploads to get signed params, upload the file to https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/{cloudName}/image/upload, return { url: secure_url, publicId: public_id }. Reuse the CloudinaryUploadResponse shape.

Refactor src/components/admin/product-form.tsx to use uploadImageToCloudinary (remove the inline uploadToCloudinary duplication, mapping to { imageUrl, imagePublicId }). Add an optional multi-file input `<input type='file' multiple accept='image/*'>` labelled 'Additional images (optional)'. On submit, after the main upload, upload each selected sub-image file, then include `subImages: uploaded.map((u, i) => ({ url: u.url, publicId: u.publicId, sortOrder: i }))` in the POST /api/products body. Keep the main image required and existing fields/behavior intact.

Edit src/components/admin/product-row.tsx: extend the AdminProduct type with `imageUrl: string; imagePublicId: string | null; images: { id: string; url: string }[]`. Render a small next/image thumbnail (e.g. 48x48, rounded) as the FIRST in both the display row and the edit row. In edit mode add: (a) Replace main image — a file input that on change calls uploadImageToCloudinary then PATCH /api/products/[id] with { imageUrl, imagePublicId } and router.refresh(); (b) sub-image management — list current images with a small Remove button each calling DELETE /api/products/[id]/images/[imageId], plus an Add file input that uploads then POST /api/products/[id]/images with { url, publicId }, then router.refresh(). In the display row's Actions cell add a red 'Delete permanently' button (border-red-600 text-red-700 or bg-red-600 text-white) that runs window.confirm then DELETE /api/products/[id]?mode=hard; on a non-ok response show the returned error (e.g. the 409 existing-orders message) in the existing error

. Keep the Deactivate button unchanged.

Edit src/app/(admin)/admin/products/page.tsx: add a leading `<th>` 'Image' in the table head, and pass imageUrl, imagePublicId, and images into each <ProductRow product={{ ... }}>. (The page already fetches all products via prisma.product.findMany; add `include: { images: { orderBy: [{ sortOrder: 'asc' }, { createdAt: 'asc' }] } }` so images are available.)

Create scripts/seed-subimages.mjs: import { PrismaClient } from '../src/generated/prisma/index.js' (or the generated entry) and node:fs. For each product in prisma.product.findMany(), if it has zero ProductImage rows, check public/brand/sample-side.jpg and public/brand/sample-back.jpg with fs.existsSync; create ProductImage rows for whichever exist with urls '/brand/sample-side.jpg' (sortOrder 0) and '/brand/sample-back.jpg' (sortOrder 1). If neither file exists, console.log a skip note and continue without throwing. Never create or duplicate Product rows. Disconnect in finally.
acceptance_criteria: The admin product list shows a thumbnail as the first column under a new 'Image' header for every row.
The create form can optionally upload multiple sub-images that are saved as ProductImage rows (visible in the storefront gallery).
In a row's edit mode the admin can replace the main image and add/remove sub-images, with the list refreshing after each action.
A red 'Delete permanently' button exists separate from 'Deactivate'; it confirms, calls ?mode=hard, and shows the server error when the product has existing orders.
`node scripts/seed-subimages.mjs` runs without error — attaching sample images when the files are present and skipping gracefully when absent, never creating duplicate products.
`npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx next lint` pass; `npm run build` succeeds.
verification: Kill node, then `node scripts/seed-subimages.mjs` exits 0 (attaches or gracefully skips).
Kill node (and `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next` if a stale build errors), then `npm run build` succeeds. Note for user: restart `npm run dev` afterward.
findings:
Created src/lib/upload-image.ts exporting uploadImageToCloudinary(file) -> { url, publicId }, lifting the exact signed direct-upload flow (POST /api/uploads for signed params, then upload to https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/{cloudName}/image/upload). product-form.tsx refactored to use it (removed the inline uploadToCloudinary + CloudinaryUploadResponse duplication), mapping the main image to { imageUrl, imagePublicId }. Added an optional 'Additional images (optional)' multi-file input (subFiles state); on submit the main image uploads first, then each sub-image sequentially (preserving order), and subImages: [{ url, publicId, sortOrder: i }] is included in the POST /api/products body. Main image stays required; existing fields/behavior intact; subFiles reset on success. product-row.tsx: AdminProduct extended with imageUrl, imagePublicId: string | null, images: { id; url }[]. A 48x48 rounded next/image thumbnail is the FIRST in both display and edit rows. Edit mode adds: Replace main image (hidden file input -> uploadImageToCloudinary -> PATCH /api/products/[id] { imageUrl, imagePublicId } -> router.refresh), a list of current sub-images each with a Remove button (DELETE /api/products/[id]/images/[imageId]), and an Add image input (POST /api/products/[id]/images { url, publicId }); all refresh after each action. Display Actions cell gains a red (bg-red-600 text-brand-white) 'Delete permanently' button: window.confirm then DELETE /api/products/[id]?mode=hard, surfacing the server error (incl. the 409 existing-orders message) in the existing error

. Deactivate button left unchanged. admin products page.tsx: findMany now includes images ordered by sortOrder asc then createdAt asc; added a leading 'Image' ; passes imageUrl, imagePublicId, and images (mapped to { id, url }) into each ProductRow. scripts/seed-subimages.mjs: imports PrismaClient from ../src/generated/prisma/index.js + node:fs/path/url; filters SAMPLES (/brand/sample-side.jpg sortOrder 0, /brand/sample-back.jpg sortOrder 1) by fs.existsSync under public/; for each product with zero ProductImage rows createMany the available samples (idempotent — skips products that already have images); logs a skip note and returns without throwing when no sample files exist; never creates/duplicates Product rows; $disconnect in finally. Verification: npx tsc --noEmit passes; npx next lint passes (no warnings/errors); node scripts/seed-subimages.mjs attached 2 sample images to all 4 products on first run and reported 'nothing to do' on re-run (idempotent); npm run build succeeds (/admin/products compiles, both image API routes listed). Thumbnails use Cloudinary imageUrl (already allowed in next.config.ts remotePatterns).
